game.name: Umamusume: Pretty Derby
game.notes: Schedule checked 2026-10-13. Current official notices confirm the October 7–24 Holiday Celebration Part 2 umbrella, Sagittarius Cup (Oct 10–16), and Sparkly Magic Show story event (Oct 15–18), with independently described login, present, Team Trials, and Daily Race programs. No upcoming patch/version is stated because no reliable official version announcement was found. Game8's October 2026 schedule is used only as secondary context; unsupported speculative/reported dates are omitted.

events.title: Champions Meeting: Sagittarius Cup
events.summary: Live Champions Meeting race event at Nakayama Turf 2,500m, with league, round, and final-rank-dependent rewards.
events.description: The official UTC availability is Oct 10 at 22:00 through Oct 16 at 21:59. League selection runs Oct 7–14; Round 1 is Oct 10–12, Round 2 Oct 12–14, and the final round concludes Oct 16. Participate with a registered team of three Veteran Umamusume. The official notice describes variable round/rank rewards and exclusive titles, so no total reward amount is asserted.
events.gameplay: Register for the Graded or Open League and enter race rounds with a team of three Veteran Umamusume.
requirements: Register a team of three Veteran Umamusume

rewards.note: league participation reward
league participation reward

rewards.item: Sagittarius Cup event rewards and exclusive titles
rewards.note: round/rank dependent; no fixed total stated

events.rewardsSummary: Toughness 30 ×3 + Alarm Clock ×3 for league participation; additional round/rank-dependent rewards and event-exclusive titles (variable).

events.title: Holiday Celebration Part 2
events.summary: Holiday Celebration umbrella event page featuring Tokyo Mega Illumination collaboration activities and multiple time-limited rewards.
events.description: Official notice says Part 2 began Oct 7 at 22:00 UTC. The event page is available through Oct 24 at 21:59 UTC; its contents include a login bonus, a holiday present, Team Trials Rally, additional Daily Race entry tickets, and the Oct 15–18 Sparkly Magic Show story event. The component programs are also listed individually where their own dates and rewards are specified.
events.gameplay: Visit the Sparkly Magic Show event page and participate in its concurrently available limited-time activities.
events.rewardsSummary: Multiple component event rewards; see the individually listed Holiday Celebration activities. No combined reward total stated.

events.title: Sparkly Magic Show (Tokyo Mega Illumination collaboration)
events.summary: Tokyo Mega Illumination collaboration story event featuring Copano Rickey, Hokko Tarumae, and Wonder Acute.
events.description: Official availability is Oct 15 at 22:00 through Oct 18 at 21:59 UTC. The notice identifies the collaboration and featured Umamusume but says full details will be released in the in-game notice when the event begins; event-specific reward quantities are therefore not asserted.
events.gameplay: Participate in the Tokyo Mega Illumination collaboration event during its announced availability period.
events.rewardsSummary: Event-specific rewards not yet detailed in the official announcement.

events.title: Sparkly Magic Show Holiday Login Bonus
events.summary: Log in for up to 12 days of holiday rewards, including Carats, items, and support points.
events.description: The official login bonus runs Oct 7 at 22:00 through Oct 19 at 14:59 UTC. Rewards are listed by login day: 150 Carats, Book of Hints ×5, Friend Pt ×500, Goddess Statue ×1, Carrot Jelly Mini ×5, Pleasing Parfait ×5, Tokyo Daishoten Winner's Sash ×10, then Support Pt ×1,000 on each of login days 8–12. A separate 500-Carat holiday present is recorded separately.
events.gameplay: Log in during the availability period to claim the daily login bonus rewards.

login day 2

events.title: Sparkly Magic Show Holiday Present
events.summary: One-time holiday gift of 500 Carats claimable during a two-day window.
events.description: The official availability window is Oct 19 at 15:00 through Oct 21 at 14:59 UTC. The gift can be obtained once during the period.
events.gameplay: Log in and claim the holiday present during the availability period.

rewards.note: one-time holiday present

events.title: Sparkly Magic Show Event Page Daily Gift
events.summary: Claim one daily gift from the event page: either Monies ×500 or Support Points ×500.
events.description: Gift appearance period is Oct 7 at 22:00 through Oct 20 at 21:59 UTC. The official notice says one gift is available per day, either Monies ×500 or Support Points ×500; it does not state a combined fixed total because the daily option may vary.
events.gameplay: Select the present icon on the Sparkly Magic Show event page once per day during the gift appearance period.

rewards.note: one of two daily gift choices
one of two daily gift choices

events.rewardsSummary: One daily choice of Monies ×500 or Support Points ×500; selectable gift appears through Oct 20 UTC.

events.title: Team Trials Rally
events.summary: Holiday giveaway distributing Carrot Jelly Mini ×3 on scheduled dates during the Team Trials Rally.
events.description: Official notice sets the availability period to Oct 7 at 22:00 through Oct 24 at 21:59 UTC and lists ten distributions of Carrot Jelly Mini ×3, from Oct 7 through Oct 16. Gifts distributed up to the point of login can still be received; expiry is Oct 24 at 21:59 UTC. The availability period is not an assertion that additional distributions occur after Oct 16.
events.gameplay: Log in to receive the Rally gifts already distributed; claim them before the stated expiry.

rewards.note: 10 listed distributions ×3 from Oct 7–16; claimable through Oct 24

events.rewardsSummary: Carrot Jelly Mini ×30 across the ten published distributions (Oct 7–16); unclaimed gifts expire Oct 24 UTC.

events.title: Bonus Daily Race Entry Tickets
events.summary: Daily Race Ticket replenishment is increased by three during the announced holiday period.
events.description: Official availability runs Oct 8 at 15:00 through Oct 24 at 14:59 UTC. Daily Race Entry Tickets are replenished by three more than usual each day. The notice cautions that only the standard three unused tickets carry over at the end of the event period.
events.gameplay: Use the increased daily replenishment to enter Daily Races during the event period.

rewards.note: three additional replenished per day; exact number collected depends on daily participation

events.rewardsSummary: Three additional Daily Race Entry Tickets replenished per day during the event period; no fixed overall total.

events.title: Spotlight Scouts: Zenno Rob Roy, Light Hello, and Mayano Top Gun
events.summary: Spotlight Trainee Scout debuts Zenno Rob Roy; the Support Card Scout features Light Hello and Mayano Top Gun.
events.description: Official availability is Oct 7 at 22:00 through Oct 15 at 21:59 UTC. The trainee scout features the debut 3★ [Heroic Author] Zenno Rob Roy; the support scout features SSR [From the Ground Up] Light Hello and SSR [Party Formation] Mayano Top Gun. Acquiring the spotlighted 3★ trainee grants Star Piece ×90 as a scout bonus. Scout pulls are not rewards and no pull currency cost is encoded here.
events.gameplay: Use the Trainee and Support Card Scouts during their availability period.

rewards.item: [Heroic Author] Zenno Rob Roy Star Piece
rewards.note: bonus each time the spotlighted 3★ trainee is acquired, including via Trainee Exchange Points

events.rewardsSummary: Zenno Rob Roy Star Piece ×90 bonus when acquiring the spotlighted 3★ trainee; scouting itself requires in-game scout resources.

events.title: Zenno Rob Roy Umamusume Story Sneak Peek
events.summary: Episodes 1–4 of Zenno Rob Roy's Umamusume Story are temporarily unlocked, with first-watch rewards available.
events.description: Official sneak peek availability is Oct 7 at 22:00 through Oct 15 at 21:59 UTC. Episodes 1–4 can be watched even without obtaining Zenno Rob Roy; first-watch carat rewards, Umamusume Story rewards, and Archive experience are earned only if watched during the sneak peek period.
events.gameplay: Complete the tutorial, open Zenno Rob Roy's story, and watch episodes 1–4 during the sneak peek period.

rewards.note: official notice does not quantify the rewards

events.rewardsSummary: First-watch carat rewards, Umamusume Story rewards, and Archive experience; exact quantities not specified in the notice.

events.title: Illuminate the Heart — Reward Collection Period
events.summary: The story event has ended, but its reward collection period remains open through Oct 15 UTC.
events.description: The official notice states the event ended Oct 12 at 22:00 UTC and rewards remain collectable until Oct 15 at 21:59 UTC. During collection, players can collect unreceived event mission rewards, play Prize Derby, and view story chapters unlocked before the event ended. Event missions can no longer be completed.
events.gameplay: Access the event screen to collect outstanding mission rewards and play Prize Derby before the collection period closes.

rewards.note: collect previously earned rewards; no fixed amounts stated in closure notice

events.rewardsSummary: Previously earned mission rewards remain collectable through Oct 15 UTC; no new missions or fixed payout stated.

events.title: Career Bonus Star Pieces: Japan Cup
events.summary: Limited Japan Cup Career entries offered bonus Star Pieces once per day.
events.description: Official notice states the bonus period was Oct 6 at 15:00 through Oct 8 at 14:59 UTC. Entering the Japan Cup in Career granted bonus [O Sole Suo!] T.M. Opera O Star Pieces once per day, with more for winning; the total quantity was not specified.
events.gameplay: Enter the Japan Cup in Career once per day during the bonus period; winning grants more bonus Star Pieces.
requirements: Enter the Japan Cup in Career

rewards.item: [O Sole Suo!] T.M. Opera O Star Piece
rewards.note: bonus once per day; quantity depends on result and not specified in notice

events.rewardsSummary: Bonus [O Sole Suo!] T.M. Opera O Star Pieces (quantity varies; more for a win); event ended Oct 8 UTC.
